gaps: No public RSS or Atom endpoint was verified for any of the 10 institutions.

No public JSON/API source was verified for any of the 10 institutions. Copenhagen Zoo and ZooParc de Beauval explicitly disallow or block common API paths; those paths are not proposed as crawler sources.

Several institutions expose more complete current material in their local language than in English; each record identifies the source language and any stale or sparse English fallback.
